facts.value: The International Office of Economics is the central point of contact for all students in the department with questions about international topics. It specifically advises students on organizing a study abroad and supports guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

facts.value: International students receive a simplified introduction to Goethe University and Frankfurt through a Frankfurt Buddy. Experienced students provide support in navigating the campus, studying, and living in Frankfurt, facilitating intercultural and linguistic exchange. The goal is to ease the transition for international students into life in Frankfurt while allowing all participants to meet interesting new people from various countries.
